title: Reducing Assumptions, Exploding Your Code
summary: A technical blog post from the Rye programming language blog discussing strategies for reducing assumptions in code and leveraging the 'explode' feature to handle complex data structures more flexibly.
problem_solved: Helps developers minimize hidden assumptions in code that can lead to bugs and maintenance issues
why_valuable: Promotes cleaner, more predictable code by making implicit behaviors explicit and easier to reason about
